reason: After pushing a branch the agent's turn ended on its own notice 'API Error: 529 Overloaded. This is a server-side issue, usually temporary - try again in a moment. If it persists, check https://status.claude.com.' with 'Brewed for 6m 34s - done 9:30 AM'. The session is stopped on the provider's outage notice, not on finished work, which is what the outage rule watches for. (The owner did type continue a minute later, and it recovered - that keystroke is deliberately not in this window, because the screen the rule would have judged is the one before it.)
factsNote: Agent, machine and repository come from the roster row returned by cc-devthrottle session list --json at capture. The activity state is not the roster's state at capture (the session had moved on since this moment); it is read off the screen itself, where the turn summary line and the empty composer show the session had stopped here.
